parent_objective: design first replay gates for the M1118 best pre-replay candidate
blocked_by: M1118 passed only pre-replay exact and anchor gates
invalidates: running full replay without first-replay design
running PPO before M1118 replay gates

public_gates: M1119 may design first replay gates for the M1118 best candidate
M1119 must not train actor weights
M1119 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip old public or source-diverse first replay
do not treat M1118 pre-replay pass as driver improvement

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs old-public and source-diverse first replay gates for the M1118 candidate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: replay design only; no replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if the M1118 best candidate artifact is missing
stop if first replay order skips M1112 failed target-base surfaces
stop if family-source rows are treated as training anchors
fallback_plan: if old-public replay design is insufficient, route to proof-gate wrapper audit
if family-source rows require materialization, design that before training from them
if design is coherent, run first replay in the next milestone

training_stage.stage_objective: design closed-loop proof replay gates for the M1118 candidate
admission_evidence: M1118 best candidate passes exact and anchor pre-replay gates
allowed_updates: manifest, queue, status, scoreboard, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: old public first replay surfaces are specified
source-diverse first replay surfaces are specified
behavior gates are ordered after proof replay

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1119 designs replay checks for wrong-history proof and cannot prove anticipatory self-identification.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1119 adds no new task and only designs replay evaluation.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If replay design shows missing coverage, route to gate-design repair rather than running replay.
allowed_claims: first replay design readiness for level2 proof-retention candidate
no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: The M1118 best pre-replay candidate can be evaluated with a first replay gate that targets the exact old-public and source-diverse surfaces that failed in M1112 before any full replay or promotion.
success_criteria: old public first replay surfaces are listed
source-diverse first replay surfaces are listed
family-intersection rows remain mandatory diagnostics but not training anchors
candidate checkpoint and base checkpoint are fixed
no replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: design skips M1112 failed target-base surfaces
design uses short-family hidden states as training anchors
replay, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1119 may only design first replay gates for M1118. It cannot run replay, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or treat M1118 as driver improvement.
